task.original_goal: Implement an Android Calm Utility prototype offline search results slice that displays a short, readable matched-text snippet for full-body search hits, with clear no-match and unavailable-index states, entirely offline and without changing search index schema or safety review status.
task.roadmap_source: docs/OFFLINE_SEARCH_BULK_ROADMAP.md S2 (relevance and search UX); DESIGN.md Calm Utility; docs/PRODUCT_BRIEF.md offline reference prototype
task.implementation_hint: Worker 1 first inspect current Android search UI, result models and available text retrieval on the approved integration base, and all open draft PRs #22-#25. Freeze an achievable vertical slice: reuse existing indexed result IDs and installed article content; show a bounded context snippet around matched query terms, with accessible fallback for title-only matches and corrupt/unavailable index. Do not copy unmerged PR code, add network requests, publish new guides or imply expert review. If equivalent UI already exists or approved base lacks required APIs, select a different independently buildable approved S2 Android slice before freezing.

acceptance_criteria: Worker 1 verifies on the approved integration base that the chosen search-results snippet UI is not already implemented and freezes precise affected paths and test plan.
Android search results display concise bounded text context for an offline body-text match, with readable fallback when no context is available; retain stable guide navigation and category filters.
Empty query, zero results and missing/corrupt index present honest accessible states without claiming live warnings, verified safety content or network connectivity.
No external search requests, new permissions, schema/tokenizer changes, unreviewed content publication or dependency on unmerged PRs #22-#25.
Run focused Android tests and Gradle debug compile on exact branch head in read-only standard public CI; record job, head SHA, pass/fail and unverified physical P30 testing.
excluded_scope: No production launch, merge, APK release, payments or personal-data collection
No safety guide changes, external requests, live alerts or expert-review claims
No index builder/schema migration or use of unmerged PR changes
No visual rebrand or unrelated feature expansion
